prefab.name: WordPress
prefab.description: WordPress site with its MariaDB database.

debug.label: Debug mode
debug.help: Shows PHP errors. Avoid in production.

db_password.label: Database password
db_password.help: Generated at deployment, shared by WordPress and MariaDB.

config_extra.label: Extra configuration
config_extra.help: PHP code appended to wp-config.php (define constants…).

cron.label: Run cron
cron.help: Runs WordPress background tasks (wp-cron.php); schedule it every 5 minutes.

fix-owner.label: Fix file owners
fix-owner.help: Gives the files back to the Apache user after an SFTP upload or an extraction.
